newsitem.title: USA: Lowe's stock falls after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Lowe's stock falls after profit warning.

text.p: Lowe's Cos. Inc.'s stock fell 10 percent Thursday after the speciality retailer of home improvement products said it expected its fourth-quarter earnings to fall below Wall Street expectations.
Lowe's stock fell $3.875 to $39.50 in heavy trading on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was one of the most actively traded issues.

The company, which has 391 stores in 24 states, said its third-quarter earnings should be higher than the 36 cents a share forecast by Wall Street analysts, but the fourth quarter was anticipated to be lower than the 32 cents forecast by analysts.
In last year's fourth quarter Lowe's earned $38 million, or 24 cents a share. For the full year ended Feb. 21 Lowe earned $226 million, or $1.41 a share.
Lowe's, which plans to announce its third-quarter earnings Nov. 13, also said that analysts's estimates of $1.63 a share for its fiscal year ending Jan. 31 were "reasonable."

The company, based in North Wilkesboro, N.C., also said its sales in October expanded by 22 percent to $671.9 million from $549.1 million, helped by strong sales in higher margin categories such as plumbing, electrical appliances, tools, and home decor.
